title.narrative: Meghalaya Multisectoral Project for Adolescent Wellbeing, Empowerment and Resilience (MPOWER)

description.narrative: The project expects to benefit about 500,000 adolescents across Meghalaya. Of these, about 400,000 are expected to be adolescents enrolled in schools, and 100,000 will be out of school adolescents. At least 49 percent of these beneficiaries are expected to be adolescent girls. Overall, the project will directly or indirectly benefit all adolescents in Meghalaya through the programmatic approach built into the Multi-sectoral Competency and Well-being Framework.
To enhance multi-sectoral service delivery and capability of the State of Meghalaya to improveadolescents' human capital outcomes
